snippet.title: Stop Wasting Money on Supplements! Ask AI Instead
snippet.description:
Most of the supplements in your cabinet right now are a waste of money. Here's how I use free AI to find out which ones are actually worth taking.

👉 See what YOU would look like with six-pack abs — free AI preview: https://absbyai.com/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=video_ad_description&utm_campaign=dgen-conv-ad4

I've spent tens of thousands of dollars on supplements. Now I take a photo of my shelf and AI reads every label, checks the real amounts behind the proprietary blends, and tells me what to keep, what to cut and what I'm missing. No affiliate links, nothing to sell.

Chapters
0:00 Stop wasting money on supplements
0:14 What I used to spend on supplements
0:41 1. AI builds a science-based stack
1:16 2. The people telling you what to take are selling it
1:37 3. Proprietary blends hide the doses
1:56 4. Nobody checks your stack against your medicine cabinet
2:08 How I know this
2:48 How the app works
3:05 Take a photo of your supplements
3:16 What the AI audit tells you
3:47 Generate your future self

Some images in this video are AI-generated, including the "future self" picture of me. The before picture and the photo-shoot photos are real. AI-generated goal images are illustrations of a possible result, not a guarantee. This video is not medical advice — talk to your doctor before changing what you take.
